_comment: Every edge-function secret a marae project can need, grouped by what it is for. NAMES ONLY: no value ever lives in this repo. 'source' says where the value comes from when scripts/provision-secrets.sh sets it: platform = Supabase supplies it, nothing to do; shared = same value for every marae, read from the file named in SHARED_FILE (kept on John's computer only); derived = worked out from the marae's website address; generated = made fresh per marae (not set by this script); manual = needs a person (see note). Groups with default:true are set for every new marae; the others only with --with <group>. Names found by scanning Deno.env.get in supabase/functions on 16 Nov 2026.

core.note: needed by the pages, reports and notification emails every marae uses

secrets.name: CRONITOR_PING_URL
secrets.note: one monitor per marae, created in Cronitor by a person

secrets.name: LOGIN_CHECK_EMAIL
secrets.note: a dedicated test login created inside that marae

secrets.name: LOGIN_CHECK_PASSWORD
secrets.note: never typed into chat or a script argument

backup.note: per-marae bucket and key, set up with the backup step
